text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 22px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203e49

g.text: LT24-D01 / Continuous power and drive correction

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203e49

g.text: OEM fan-specific reference; installed power and controls remain unapproved

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #b95035

g.text: LT24 · 21 OCT 2026 · ENGINEERING COMPARISON · NOT FOR FABRICATION

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203e49

g.text: 35 kW trial at 3.5 mph: 97.19 L/min · 174.75 bar motor differential · 15.00 kN rim pull.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203e49

g.text: 350 bar is a low-speed comparison, not a full-flow command. Beyond about 4 mph, trial pump flow is insufficient.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203e49

g.text: The quote’s 55.4 kW “net intermittent” description conflicts with the OEM rating table; obtain package confirmation.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203e49

g.text: At 2,600 rpm: 35 kW = 128.6 Nm. If all 45 kW passes through one shaft, demand = 165.3 Nm.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203e49

g.text: At 1,500 rpm the same 45 kW needs 286.5 Nm. Torque and power limits must both constrain pump displacement.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203e49

g.text: G4 13-tooth shaft: 180 / 222 Nm rated / maximum. G5 15-tooth: 277 / 370 Nm. Coupling acceptance remains open.
